body: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments across search, tool-use, and automation tasks with 4B and 30B-A3B models demonstrate consistent gains over strong RL baselines.
summaryZh: 长视野 LLM 代理的多尺度策略优化。长视野 LLM 代理通过完整的助理轮流与其环境交互，同时逐个生成每个操作令牌。我们观察到，评论家的价值主要在不同回合之间有所不同，从而激励以轮次为基础的优化，并在代币之间进行更精细的信用分配。
